meaning: 2D Regge hinge deficit curvature and boundary Gauss-Bonnet holonomy benchmark across 5 model families (Theorem 88): on a 4-triangle square-pyramid star (chi = 1), Phase 1 equilateral triangles (1/6, 1/6, 1/6) close locally while creating interior hinge deficit eps_apex = 1/3 and boundary turn sum 2/3 < 1 (Delta_E = -1); Phase 2 under-flattened triangles (5/24, 7/48, 7/48) leave residual deficit eps_apex = 1/6 (Delta_E = -1); Phase 3 right-isosceles triangles (1/4, 1/8, 1/8) achieve zero interior deficit eps_apex = 0 and boundary turn sum 1 == chi (Delta_E = 0).
